behavior: A custom 404 page in the site's style with its own illustration and a way back home
acceptance: Given an unknown URL, then the response is 404 and the page shows the custom illustration, a short message and a link back to the home page, in both themes
notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: Pass. Evidence: playwright 18/18 passed incl. smoke 'unknown URL returns 404 with a way back home' and kit 404 tests; check-images: 5 images all recorded; pnpm lint clean (151 files); pnpm typecheck passed. Manual prod server on :3110: /no-such-page, /kit, /kit/directions all return HTTP 404, title 'Page not found · Forwend', meta robots noindex,nofollow, and /kit body renders the custom page (title, not-found.webp, Back to Forwend). Image alt="" (decorative), both links href="/". Screenshots: text readable in light (radial bg veil) and dark (brightness-50); mobile 390 shows the waterfall; uses font-display text-section, text-ink/text-muted tokens and shared buttonClasses lg, matching the landing. No generation mention in UI copy. Nits, not blocking: not-found.tsx:25 comment says 'a fade into the page at the bottom' but the gradient is only a radial veil, no bottom fade; the 404 inherits canonical '/' from layout.tsx (harmless with noindex); Next also adds its own robots noindex meta, so two robots tags appear.
